复合形容词，义为「本科层次的」

senses.title: A student without a first degree
senses.definition: a student working toward a bachelor’s degree
senses.definitionCN: 正在攻读学士学位的学生
senses.example: The lab takes two undergraduates each summer.
senses.exampleCN: 这个实验室每年夏天招收两名本科生。
senses.why: Graduare in Latin means to take a step, and gradus is a step; under marks the stage below the degree step.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 graduare 意为迈一步，gradus 是台阶；under 标记学位那一级之下的阶段。

senses.title: A student at a college in the first cycle
senses.definition: a person at college in their first course of higher study
senses.definitionCN: 在大学第一级课程中就读的人
senses.example: Undergraduates here live in colleges, not flats.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的大学生住在学院里，而不在校外公寓。
senses.why: British universities above all use the word to separate students from postgraduates on the same campus.
senses.whyCN: 尤以英国大学如此，用这个词把同一校园里的本科生与研究生区分开。

senses.title: Study at the first level
senses.definition: used before nouns for courses and degrees below master’s level
senses.definitionCN: 用于硕士水平以下的课程与学位名词之前
senses.example: She teaches an undergraduate seminar on poetry.
senses.exampleCN: 她教一门本科诗歌研讨课。
senses.why: The noun freely becomes a label for the whole level of study.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词又自由地转作整个学习阶段的标签。

senses.title: A part that is still in progress
senses.titleCN: 尚未完成本科阶段的人
senses.definition: a person whose degree is not yet awarded and so not yet a graduate
senses.definitionCN: 学位尚未授予、因而还不算 graduate 的人
senses.example: He is an undergraduate until the results come out.
senses.exampleCN: 成绩公布之前他还算本科生。
senses.why: The prefix is a status marker: the step has not been taken yet.
senses.whyCN: 前缀是个身份标记：那一步还没有迈出去。

senses.title: A young member of a learned community
senses.definition: in older usage, a beginning student within a college
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指学院里刚开始学习的人
senses.example: In 1820 the college had forty undergraduates.
senses.exampleCN: 1820 年这所学院有四十名在读学生。
senses.why: In that older world the word simply placed a beginner at the foot of the college ladder.
senses.whyCN: 在那个更早的世界里，这个词只是把一个初学者放在学院梯子的最下一级。

intro.en: The word is a Latin step, with an English prefix marking the stage below it.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语的「一步」，加英语前缀标记那一步之下的阶段。

items.en: Gradus means a step or a degree, and gradus honoris is an academic degree.
items.cn: gradus 意为台阶或等级，gradus honoris 即学位。

items.en: Graduare means to take a degree, and the medieval university is its stage.
items.cn: graduare 意为取得学位，其舞台就是中世纪大学。

items.en: The noun graduate enters English from that academic sense.
items.cn: graduate 由这层学术义进入英语。

items.en: Undergraduate is formed with the prefix to name students below the degree step.
items.cn: 加上前缀构成 undergraduate，指位于学位台阶之下的学生。

items.en: The Oxford and Cambridge systems fix the British usage in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪牛津与剑桥的制度把英式用法固定下来。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the grad- stem of steps and degrees, and the near-meaning group names student roles.
note.cn: 形近组共用表示台阶与学位的 grad- 词干，近义组列出学生身份。

entries.definition: a person who has a degree
the ceremony of taking a degree
a student beyond a first degree
a student in the final year

normalIntro.en: Gradus is a step, so an undergraduate has not yet stepped onto the degree level.
normalIntro.cn: gradus 是台阶，undergraduate 就是还没踏上学位那一级的人。

normal.en: Graduate means the step has been taken, and undergraduate means it has not.
normal.cn: graduate 表示已迈上那一步，undergraduate 表示还没迈上。

normal.en: Grade and gradual come from the same step, one a rank, one a pace.
normal.cn: grade 与 gradual 同出这一步，一个是等级，一个是步伐。

normal.en: In British use undergraduates are at college, while postgraduates remain after the degree.
normal.cn: 英式用法里本科生在学院读书，postgraduate 是拿过学位后继续读的人。

normal.en: Undergrad is the joking short form heard on campus.
normal.cn: 校园里常听到打趣的缩略说法 undergrad。

normal.en: The plural undergraduates is regular, with no change of the stem.
normal.cn: 复数 undergraduates 规则变化，词干不变。

abstract.en: See a staircase with the degree marked one step higher.
abstract.cn: 看见一段楼梯，学位那一级标得更高一点。

abstract.en: Watch a young person standing one step below it with books.
abstract.cn: 看一个年轻人抱着书站在它下面一级。

abstract.en: Notice that the sign on that step never names the person, only the gap.
abstract.cn: 注意那一级上的标牌并不叫出人名，只标出这段差距。

examples.en: Most undergraduates live on campus in their first year.
examples.cn: 大多数本科生第一年住在校内。

examples.en: He completed an undergraduate degree in economics.
examples.cn: 他修完了经济学本科学位。

examples.en: The journal is written for undergraduates, not specialists.
examples.cn: 这份刊物是给本科生而不是专家看的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安得瓜爵特」——还没安得上学位这顶「爵」帽，所以只能叫本科生。

root: under-（在……之下）+ graduate（拉丁语 gradus「台阶、等级」→ graduare「取得学位」）；同族有 grade、graduation、postgraduate

sensesIntro.en: The word marks a place on a staircase: below the step where a degree is taken.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词标记楼梯上的位置：在授予学位那一级之下。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a young person standing one step below the degree.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个年轻人站在学位那一级的下方。

branches.en: The person branch: the student working toward a degree.
branches.cn: 人分支：正在攻读学位的学生。

branches.en: The labelling branch: courses, degrees, and journals.
branches.cn: 标签分支：课程、学位与刊物。

branches.en: The status branch: not yet counted among graduates.
branches.cn: 身份分支：还不在毕业生之列。

branches.en: The older branch: a beginning member of a college.
branches.cn: 旧义分支：学院里初入门的人。

branches.en: The plain campus sense heard every September.
branches.cn: 每年九月都能听到的校园义。

intro.en: An English prefix on a Latin word for a step.
intro.cn: 英语前缀加在表示「台阶」的拉丁词上。

latinIntro.en: The grad- root of steps also gives grade, gradual, and progress.
latinIntro.cn: 表示台阶的 grad- 词根还生出 grade、gradual、progress。

items.example: Under- marks the stage below a degree.
items.exampleCN: under- 标记学位之下的一级。

items.example: Graduare means to take a degree.
Undergraduate names the person at that stage.
items.exampleCN: undergraduate 指处于该阶段的人。

definition_zh: 地下的；秘密的；地下组织；（英）地铁
definition_en: below the surface of the ground, or hidden from public view
core_image: 在土层之下，一条亮着灯的线路悄悄延伸
scene: 冬天地面结着薄冰，人们缩着脖子下到楼梯深处，那里暖风阵阵、车灯闪动。They took the underground across the city.
sceneCN: 这里 underground 是「地铁（英式）」（第 2 个义项：地下的交通系统）；句意为他们乘地铁穿城而过。土层下亮灯延伸的线路，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉前缀的原词，义为「地面；场地」
复合名词加 -er，义为「地下工作者」
美式同义词，义为「地铁」

senses.title: Below the surface of the earth
senses.definition: placed or happening under the surface of the ground
senses.definitionCN: 位于或发生于地表之下
senses.example: The city built a huge underground car park.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市建了一个巨大的地下停车场。
senses.why: Ground is the surface we stand on, and under puts the whole system beneath it.
senses.whyCN: ground 是我们脚下的地表，under 把整套东西放到它下面。

senses.title: A city railway below the streets
senses.definition: the railway system that runs in tunnels under a city
senses.definitionCN: 在城市街道下方的隧道中运行的铁路系统
senses.example: The underground is quicker than the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 地铁比公交车快。
senses.why: Londoners shortened the full name to the underground, and the noun took over.
senses.whyCN: 伦敦人把这套系统的全名缩作 the underground，名词就此定型。

senses.title: Hidden and against the authorities
senses.definition: of a movement or publication, operating in secret against a government
senses.definitionCN: 指运动或出版物在暗处与政府对抗
senses.example: The novel was passed around in underground copies.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说以地下本的形式流传。
senses.why: To operate underground is literally to be out of sight, and secrecy borrows the same picture.
senses.whyCN: 在地下活动字面上就是见不到光，秘密也就借用了这张图。

senses.title: To go into hiding
senses.definition: of a person or group, to disappear from public life
senses.definitionCN: 指人或团体从公众生活中消失
senses.example: The writer went underground for ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这位作家隐没了十年。
senses.why: When someone sinks below the surface, they can no longer be found by ordinary means.
senses.whyCN: 一个人沉到地表之下，常规手段就找不到他了。

senses.title: Secret and unofficial
senses.definition: existing in secret without official approval
senses.definitionCN: 未经官方许可而在暗中存在的
senses.example: An underground economy grew along the border.
senses.exampleCN: 边境上长出了一片地下经济。
senses.why: Money that never enters the books lives, in effect, below the visible streets.
senses.whyCN: 从不进账的钱，实际上就生活在看得见的街道下面。

intro.en: The word is an English combination of a preposition and a noun of the earth.
intro.cn: 这个词是英语介词与表示地面的名词的组合。

items.en: Grund means the bottom or the ground, and under carries the sense of beneath.
items.cn: grund 意为底部或地面，under 表示在其下。

items.en: Underground appears in the sixteenth century for things placed in the earth.
items.cn: underground 在十六世纪出现，指放在地里的东西。

items.en: The London railway takes the name in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪伦敦的铁路系统取用了这个名字。

items.en: The figurative sense of secret resistance grows in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
items.cn: 秘密抵抗的比喻义在十九、二十世纪成长起来。

items.en: American English prefers subway for the railway, keeping underground for the literal and secret senses.
items.cn: 美式英语用 subway 指地铁，underground 则保留字面义与秘密义。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers under- compounds with ground, and the near-meaning group names underground things and hidden groups.
note.cn: 形近组汇集与 ground 相关的 under- 复合词，近义组列出地下与隐蔽的事物。

entries.definition: an underground railway, chiefly in America

normalIntro.en: Ground is the surface, and everything with under in front of it lies out of sight.
normalIntro.cn: ground 是地表，前面加了 under，就都到了看不见的地方。

normal.en: The British ride the underground and Americans ride the subway.
normal.cn: 英国人乘 the underground，美国人乘 subway。

normal.en: Go underground is the fixed phrase for going into hiding.
normal.cn: go underground 是「隐匿起来」的固定说法。

normal.en: Underground press and underground economy keep the secrecy sense.
normal.cn: underground press 与 underground economy 保留秘密义。

normal.en: Underground parking, underground cables, and underground rivers are all literal.
normal.cn: underground parking、cables、rivers 都是字面用法。

normal.en: The word stays the same in the plural, as a compound noun.
normal.cn: 复合名词下复数形式不变。

abstract.en: Go down a staircase that turns twice before the light returns.
abstract.cn: 沿一段拐两次弯才重见光的楼梯走下去。

abstract.en: Hear trains running under the streets you just left.
abstract.cn: 听见列车就在刚离开的街道下面运行。

abstract.en: Then picture a meeting held where no window can be found.
abstract.cn: 再想象在一处找不到窗子的地方开会。

examples.en: The cables run underground for most of the route.
examples.cn: 这条线路大部分的电缆埋在地下。

examples.en: Take the underground to the museum, it is faster.
examples.cn: 坐地铁去博物馆吧，更快。

examples.en: After the arrest he went underground for years.
examples.cn: 被捕之后，他转入地下好几年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安卓格朗德」——安卓机器人在地面之下（ground）钻洞跑地铁。

root: under（在下，古英语）+ ground（古英语 grund「底部、地面」）；英式名词指地铁，美式作 subway

sensesIntro.en: Every sense puts something below the surface: rails, cables, cars, newspapers, and whole movements.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都把某样东西放到地表以下：铁轨、电缆、车辆、报刊乃至整场运动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit tunnel running quietly under the soil.
core.cn: 核心意象：土层下安静延伸的亮灯隧道。

branches.en: The literal branch: car parks, cables, and rivers.
branches.cn: 字面分支：停车场、电缆与河流。

branches.en: The railway branch, a noun in British English.
branches.cn: 铁路分支：英式英语里的名词。

branches.en: The secrecy branch: press and economy outside the law.
branches.cn: 秘密分支：法律之外的地下报刊与经济。

branches.en: The hiding branch: a person who disappears.
branches.cn: 隐匿分支：消失不见的人。

branches.en: The plain sense used of anything buried.
branches.cn: 最普通的义项：任何埋于地下的东西。

intro.en: A preposition of position plus a noun for the surface of the earth.
intro.cn: 方位介词加一个表示地表的古英语名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.example: Grund means the earth below us.
items.exampleCN: grund 指我们脚下的大地。

definition_zh: 在……下面；在底下；隐蔽地；（作名词）底部
definition_en: directly under something, often so as to be hidden by it
core_image: 掀开毯子一角，底下那层东西严严实实地藏着
scene: 搬家时，老沙发被抬起，底下卷着的一枚硬币和一张旧照片滚了出来。The letter was hidden underneath a stack of newspapers.
sceneCN: 这里 underneath 是「在……下面」（第 1 个义项：正下方、被遮住）；句意为那封信藏在一摞报纸下面。掀开毯角看见底下藏的那层，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 同源介词，义为「在……下面」
近义介词，义为「在……下方」
复合名词，义为「底面」

senses.title: Directly under and covered by
senses.definition: placed just under something that hides it
senses.definitionCN: 就在某物之下，被它遮住
senses.example: The cat is asleep underneath the chair.
senses.exampleCN: 猫在椅子底下睡着。
senses.why: Under is the old preposition and nīthe added a sense of below from beneath, giving a more pointed down there.
senses.whyCN: under 是古老介词，nīthe 带出 beneath 意味，合起来更强调「就在下方那一层」。

senses.title: Hidden beneath a surface
senses.definition: concealed below what shows
senses.definitionCN: 藏在外观所见之物的下面
senses.example: There is a layer of clay underneath the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 土层底下有一层黏土。
senses.why: A surface only reports its top, so whatever lies in the next layer counts as concealed.
senses.whyCN: 表面只会报出它最上面一层，所以落在下一层里的东西都算被藏住。

senses.title: Used alone for the lower side
senses.definition: used alone to mean on the underside or in the inner part
senses.definitionCN: 单独使用，指在底面或内里
senses.example: The plate is gold underneath.
senses.exampleCN: 这只盘子底下是金的。
senses.why: The adverb lets the speaker point downward without naming the object.
senses.whyCN: 副词让说话人不点出对象，只把手指往下一指。

senses.title: Beneath a surface appearance
senses.definition: below the outward manner, of feelings not displayed
senses.definitionCN: 指外表之下的情绪，未必显现出来
senses.example: Underneath he was more pleased than he showed.
senses.exampleCN: 内里他比他表现出来的更高兴。
senses.why: The physical layer beneath becomes the emotional layer beneath.
senses.whyCN: 实物的那一层之下，转成情绪的那一层之下。

senses.title: The underside of a thing
senses.definition: the lower surface of an object
senses.definitionCN: 物体的下表面
senses.example: The underneath of the boat was covered in weed.
senses.exampleCN: 船底长满了水草。
senses.why: The adverb turns into a noun by naming the lower face itself.
senses.whyCN: 副词一旦直接称呼那个下表面，就成了名词。

intro.en: The word joins under with an Old English word for below.
intro.cn: 这个词把 under 与一个古英语的「在下」词根接在一起。

items.en: Under is the inherited preposition, and neothan or nithan means from below.
items.cn: under 是固有介词，nēothan 或 nithan 意为「从下面」。

items.en: Underneothan combines both and is recorded in Old English.
items.cn: underneothan 把两者合起来，古英语已有记录。

items.en: Middle English shortens the form toward underneath as it is spelled today.
items.cn: 中古英语把形式缩短为今天的 underneath。

items.en: The figurative use for hidden feelings settles in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 指隐藏情绪的比喻用法在十九世纪定型。

items.en: The noun use for an underside is chiefly informal.
items.cn: 指底面的名词用法主要属非正式语体。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers prepositions ending in a downward element, and the near-meaning group gathers words of lower position.
note.cn: 形近组汇集带「在下」部件的介词，近义组汇集表示低处之词。

entries.definition: the lower face of a thing

normalIntro.en: Under plus an old word for below makes the most pointed of all the down words.
normalIntro.cn: under 加一个古语「在下」词，成了所有「下方」词里最实指的一个。

normal.en: Think of underneath as the exact layer hidden by the thing above.
normal.cn: 把 underneath 想成被上面那件东西遮住的那一层。

normal.en: Beneath and underneath are nearly the same, but underneath usually touches.
normal.cn: beneath 与 underneath 几乎一样，但 underneath 通常紧贴。

normal.en: Underneath as an adverb can stand after the verb, as in gold underneath.
normal.cn: underneath 作副词时能放在动词后，如 gold underneath。

normal.en: The noun use, the underneath, means the underside of a thing.
normal.cn: 名词用法 the underneath 指物体的底面。

normal.en: Underneath the surface and underneath it all are the two figurative phrases.
normal.cn: underneath the surface 与 underneath it all 是两个比喻性搭配。

abstract.en: Lift one corner of a blanket and see what stayed hidden.
abstract.cn: 掀开毯子一角，看见一直藏着的东西。

abstract.en: Notice the layer is not far away, only covered.
abstract.cn: 注意那一层并不远，只是被盖住了。

abstract.en: Then let a calm face cover a glad feeling the same way.
abstract.cn: 再让一张平静的脸以同样方式盖住喜悦。

examples.en: The dog sleeps underneath the old kitchen table.
examples.cn: 那条狗睡在旧厨房桌子底下。

examples.en: Underneath all the noise, she was a kind person.
examples.cn: 在所有的喧闹之下，她是个善良的人。

examples.en: The underneath of the shelf was still sticky with paint.
examples.cn: 架子底面还粘着油漆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺的尼思」——俺的思绪藏在最底下一层，谁都看不见。

root: under（古英语介词）+ nēothan／nithan（从下面），合为古英语 underneothan，中古英语缩短为 underneath

sensesIntro.en: The word points to the exact layer covered by something: a cat, a coin, a clay bed, or a feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词指向被某物盖住的那一层：一只猫、一枚硬币、一层黏土，或一种心情。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a corner of a blanket lifted to show what was under it.
core.cn: 核心意象：掀开毯角，露出底下藏着的东西。

branches.en: The place branch: cats, tables, and chairs.
branches.cn: 位置分支：猫、桌子与椅子。

branches.en: The layer branch: clay, coins, old letters.
branches.cn: 层叠分支：黏土、硬币与旧信。

branches.en: The adverb branch, where no object is named.
branches.cn: 副词分支：不点出对象。

branches.en: The feeling branch: what a calm surface hides.
branches.cn: 情绪分支：平静表面所藏。

branches.en: The noun branch: the underside of a boat.
branches.cn: 名词分支：船底。

intro.en: Two inherited words for below stacked into one.
intro.cn: 两个表示「在下」的固有词叠成一个。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.exampleCN: nēothan 增添了「下方」的强调。

items.example: A key lay underneath the mat.
items.exampleCN: 垫子底下放着一把钥匙。

items.example: Beneath the tree stood a bench.

definition_zh: 理解；懂得；了解；体谅；认为；听说
definition_en: to know what something means or how it works, or to know another’s feelings
core_image: 站在对方的立场上，忽然看清了他说那句话时的处境
scene: 老师把学生的作业本翻过来，看到他昨天晚上在页边写的一行小字，语气软了下来。Now I understand why she left so early.
sceneCN: 这里 understand 是「理解、明白」（第 1 个义项：懂得含义或缘由）；句意为现在我明白她为什么这么早走了。站到对方位置上看清他的处境，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ing 构成名词，义为「理解；谅解」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可以理解的」
加前缀 mis- 构成动词，义为「误解」

senses.title: To grasp the meaning of something
senses.definition: to know what words, rules, or ideas mean
senses.definitionCN: 知道文字、规则或想法的意思
senses.example: Do you understand the question?
senses.exampleCN: 你明白这个问题吗？
senses.why: The old verb stand means to be in place, so to understand is to stand in the place of a thing and see it from there.
senses.whyCN: 古语 stand 意为站立，understand 就是站到一件事的立场上去看它。

senses.title: To see the reason behind something
senses.definition: to know why something happened or was said
senses.definitionCN: 知道某事为何发生或被说出
senses.example: I understand now why he refused.
senses.exampleCN: 我现在明白他为什么拒绝了。
senses.why: Grasping a fact and grasping its reason are one act of standing in its place.
senses.whyCN: 抓住一个事实与抓住它的缘由，是同一个「站到它位置上」的动作。

senses.title: To know another person’s feelings
senses.definition: to be aware of and accept how someone feels
senses.definitionCN: 察觉并接受某人的感受
senses.example: My parents do not always understand me.
senses.exampleCN: 父母并不总能理解我。
senses.why: When you stand where another stands, feeling comes before facts.
senses.whyCN: 站到别人的位置上，感受先于事实到来。

senses.title: To believe or be told
senses.definition: to have been informed that something is so
senses.definitionCN: 据告知而认为某事如此
senses.example: I understand that the meeting has been moved.
senses.exampleCN: 我听说会议改期了。
senses.why: What you have taken in as true is also what you stand under as information.
senses.whyCN: 你当作真的收进来的消息，也是你站在其下接受的信息。

senses.title: To supply a missing word mentally
senses.definition: to take a word as implied though it is not written
senses.definitionCN: 把未写出的词含在心里补上
senses.example: In this phrase the verb is understood.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个短语里那个动词是隐含的。
senses.why: The reader joins the writer by standing in the same place and filling the gap.
senses.whyCN: 读者站到作者的同一位置，把空缺补上，两端就此接合。

intro.en: The word is an Old English compound of standing under something.
intro.cn: 这个词是古英语复合词，意为站在某物之下。

items.en: Understandan is built from under and standan, to stand, and means to stand in the midst of.
items.cn: understandan 由 under 与 standan（站立）构成，意为「站在其中」。

items.en: The prefix here is close in force to inter, so the word means to be among a thing.
items.cn: 这里的前缀效力接近 inter，因此这个词意为「处于某物之中」。

items.en: Middle English understand has already narrowed toward knowing and comprehending.
items.cn: 中古英语中 understand 已经收窄到「知晓、领会」。

items.en: The past forms understood, both past and participle, are leveled in the modern period.
items.cn: 过去式与过去分词在现代统一为 understood。

items.en: The polite sense of believing what one is told is common in business letters.
items.cn: 表示「据闻」的客气义在商务信函里很常见。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs built on stand, and the near-meaning group collects verbs of grasping meaning.
note.cn: 形近组汇集由 stand 构成的动词，近义组汇集表示领会意义的动词。

entries.definition: the ability to grasp and to be kind

normalIntro.en: Stand under a thing and look up at it from there, and you know how it stands.
normalIntro.cn: 站到一件事的下面抬头去看，就知道它到底是怎么立的。

normal.en: Understand and withstand share the verb stand, one standing among, one standing against.
normal.cn: understand 与 withstand 共用 stand，一个是站在其中，一个是顶住。

normal.en: Comprehend and grasp both picture taking hold, while understand pictures taking a place.
normal.cn: comprehend 与 grasp 都像伸手抓住，understand 则像占住一个位置。

normal.en: Understanding is the noun and also means a friendly tolerance between people.
normal.cn: understanding 既是名词「理解」，也指人与人之间的体谅。

normal.en: Misunderstand adds mis- for a wrong stand, a look from the wrong place.
normal.cn: misunderstand 加 mis-，表示站错了位置、从错处去看。

normal.en: Understood serves as both past tense and past participle.
normal.cn: understood 同时充当过去式与过去分词。

abstract.en: Step into another person’s shoes without saying a word.
abstract.cn: 不说一句话，把脚伸进别人的鞋里。

abstract.en: Look back at your own remark from there and feel it change.
abstract.cn: 从那儿回头看自己那句话，会觉得它变了样。

abstract.en: Then put a missing word into a gap and watch the sentence close.
abstract.cn: 再往空缺里填一个词，看句子合上。

examples.en: I did not understand the instructions at first.
examples.cn: 一开始我没看懂这些说明。

examples.en: She understands how hard the decision was for you.
examples.cn: 她明白这个决定对你有多难。

examples.en: We understand that the office will close early today.
examples.cn: 我们听说办公室今天会提前关门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的斯坦得」——安心地站在（stand）对方那边，自然就懂了。

root: 古英语 under（在其下／在其中）+ standan（站立），understandan 意为「站在其中」，过去式与过去分词均为 understood

sensesIntro.en: Each sense is a change of place: standing in a thing, in a reason, in a feeling, in a report, or in a gap.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都是一次换位：站进一件事、一个缘由、一种感受、一则传闻，或一处空缺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: standing where another stands and seeing what they see.
core.cn: 核心意象：站到别人站的地方，看见他所看见的。

branches.en: The language branch: meanings and implied words.
branches.cn: 语言分支：意义与隐含的词。

branches.en: The cause branch: why a thing happened.
branches.cn: 原因分支：事情为何发生。

branches.en: The people branch: standing inside another’s feeling.
branches.cn: 人分支：站进别人的感受里。

branches.en: The report branch: what one has taken in as true.
branches.cn: 传闻分支：被当作真而收进来的话。

branches.en: The plain classroom sense of getting the point.
branches.cn: 课堂里最普通的「听懂了」。

intro.en: Two native English pieces: a preposition of place and a verb of standing.
intro.cn: 两块土生英语部件：一个方位介词和一个站立的动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.example: Under here means in the midst of.
items.exampleCN: 这里的 under 意为「处于其中」。

definition_zh: 内衣；内衣物
definition_en: the light clothing worn next to the skin under other clothes
core_image: 最贴近皮肤的那一层布料，外面又被别的衣服盖住
scene: 旅行箱摊在床上，母亲把整理好的换洗内衣卷成小卷塞进侧袋。Pack clean underwear for the trip.
sceneCN: 这里 underwear 是「内衣」（第 1 个义项：贴身穿在里面的衣服）；句意为出门要带干净内衣。贴皮肤又压在外衣下面的那一层布，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 同义复合名词，义为「内衣」
复合名词，义为「贴身衣物」
去掉前缀的原词，义为「穿；戴」

senses.title: Clothes worn next to the skin
senses.definition: the clothing a person wears under outer clothes
senses.definitionCN: 穿在外衣之下的衣物
senses.example: She packed socks and underwear in the side pocket.
senses.exampleCN: 她把袜子和内衣塞进侧袋。
senses.why: The word joins under and wear, so it names what is worn underneath, without further describing the shape.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 under 与 wear 合成，直接命名「穿在下面」的东西，不再细说形状。

senses.title: A general word covering many garments
senses.definition: a collective term for vests, shorts, bras, and similar items
senses.definitionCN: 对背心、短裤、胸衣等的统称
senses.example: The shop sells underwear for the whole family.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店卖全家人的内衣。
senses.why: Because it is a mass noun, one word can cover a whole category of small garments.
senses.whyCN: 由于它是不可数名词，一个词就能盖住一整类小件衣物。

senses.title: Thermal or woollen under-layers
senses.definition: extra layers worn for warmth in cold weather
senses.definitionCN: 寒冷天气里为保暖而多加的那几层
senses.example: He wore thick wool underwear on the ship.
senses.exampleCN: 他在船上穿着厚羊毛内衣。
senses.why: Underwear in cold places is not decoration but a second skin against wind.
senses.whyCN: 在寒冷处，内衣不是装饰，而是一层抵挡风的第二皮肤。

senses.title: Worn for shaping or support
senses.titleCN: （起支撑或塑形作用的）贴身衣物
senses.definition: garments worn underneath for support or shape
senses.definitionCN: 穿在下面的支撑或塑形衣物
senses.example: The dancers bought special underwear for the costume.
senses.exampleCN: 舞者为此服装配了专门的贴身衣物。
senses.why: Anything that goes on first and supports what comes after belongs to this layer.
senses.whyCN: 任何先行穿上、支撑后续之物的东西，都属于这一层。

senses.title: A form of clothing not shown in public
senses.definition: the part of dress that convention keeps hidden
senses.definitionCN: 按习俗不外露的那部分衣着
senses.example: In that era underwear was never called by its name.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个年代，内衣这个词从不被直接说出口。
senses.why: The layer closest to the body is also the layer closest to taboo.
senses.whyCN: 最贴近身体的那一层，也最贴近禁忌。

intro.en: The word is a plain English compound of a preposition and a verb of wearing.
intro.cn: 这个词是英语的朴素复合词，由介词与表示穿着的动词构成。

items.en: Under is the inherited preposition, and werian means to clothe or to put on.
items.cn: under 是固有介词，werian 意为穿衣、穿上。

items.en: The noun wear develops from the verb in the sense of clothing.
items.cn: 名词 wear 由动词发展出「衣着」之义。

items.en: Underwear is recorded in the nineteenth century as a general word.
items.cn: underwear 在十九世纪有记录，作总称为用。

items.en: Victorian shops avoided the word in print and used euphemisms instead.
items.cn: 维多利亚时代的商号避免印出这个词，改用婉称。

items.en: Modern usage treats it as a mass noun, with a pair of for single items.
items.cn: 现代用法视作不可数名词，单件用 a pair of 表达。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers under- words for clothing, and the near-meaning group names items worn or carried close to the body.
note.cn: 形近组汇集表示衣着的 under- 词，近义组列出贴身穿戴之物。

entries.definition: a layer of paint or an under coat
a soft covering for the foot

normalIntro.en: Under plus wear reads as the clothing worn underneath, nothing more is needed.
normalIntro.cn: under 加 wear 就是「穿在下面的衣物」，无需更多解释。

normal.en: Wear is both the verb to put on and the noun for clothing, as in sportswear.
normal.cn: wear 既是「穿」这一动词，也指衣着，如 sportswear。

normal.en: Underwear is uncountable, so a single item is a pair of underwear.
normal.cn: underwear 不可数，单件要说 a pair of underwear。

normal.en: Underclothes and undergarment are near twins, one older and one more formal.
normal.cn: underclothes 与 undergarment 像一对双生，一个更旧，一个更正式。

normal.en: Thermal underwear appeared with the word for heat in the nineteen hundreds.
normal.cn: thermal underwear 二十世纪随 thermal 一词一同出现。

normal.en: Outerwear sits on the other side of the same line.
normal.cn: outerwear 站在同一条线的另一边。

abstract.en: Feel the first layer against your skin before anything else.
abstract.cn: 先感觉贴皮肤的第一层，再穿别的。

abstract.en: Notice that nobody sees it, yet everyone needs it.
abstract.cn: 注意没人看得见它，而人人又都需要它。

abstract.en: Then hear a shopkeeper of long ago talk around the word.
abstract.cn: 再听见很久以前的店主绕着这个词说话。

examples.en: Bring warm underwear for the mountain nights.
examples.cn: 山里的夜里很冷，要带保暖内衣。

examples.en: The laundry now sells socks and underwear.
examples.cn: 这家洗衣店现在也卖袜子和内衣。

examples.en: She bought several pairs of cotton underwear.
examples.cn: 她买了好几件棉质内衣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的威尔」——安安稳稳地穿在里面，只有自己知道的那层 wear。

root: under（在下，古英语）+ wear（古英语 werian「穿衣」；名词 wear 指衣着）；同义有 underclothes、undergarment

sensesIntro.en: The word is a position rather than a shape: whatever layer is closest to the body and lowest in the dress.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词说的是位置而非形状：任何最贴近身体、在衣服最里层的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the layer of cloth right against the skin.
core.cn: 核心意象：紧贴皮肤的那层布。

branches.en: The garment branch: what is worn next to the skin.
branches.cn: 衣物分支：贴身穿的那层。

branches.en: The category branch: a mass noun for the whole class.
branches.cn: 类别分支：作为统称的不可数用法。

branches.en: The function branch: warmth, support, and shaping.
branches.cn: 功能分支：保暖、支撑与塑形。

branches.en: The convention branch: the layer kept out of speech.
branches.cn: 习俗分支：不被说出口的那一层。

branches.en: The packing-list sense used on every trip.
branches.cn: 旅行清单里最常用的义项。

intro.en: A preposition and a clothing verb make one mass noun.
intro.cn: 一个介词与一个表示穿着的动词合成一个不可数名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.exampleCN: 那里叠着一件贴身衣物。

items.example: Outerwear is on the second floor.
Garment names a piece of clothing.

definition_zh: 解开；打开；取消；撤销；毁掉（某人的前途）
definition_en: to reverse something done, such as a knot, a change, or a plan
core_image: 把系紧的结一根根抽开，布又摊平了
scene: 缝纫课上，学员发现领子缝反了，只好一针针拆开再来。She had to undo three hours of work.
sceneCN: 这里 undo 是「解开、拆开」（第 1 个义项：把已做的东西还原）；句意为她不得不把三个小时的活全部拆掉。把系紧的结抽开让布摊平，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 过去分词作形容词，义为「未做完的；毁了的」
动词加 -ing 构成名词，义为「毁灭；败因」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可撤销的」

senses.title: To open what is fastened
senses.definition: to unfasten a button, a knot, or a zip
senses.definitionCN: 把纽扣、绳结或拉链松开
senses.example: He undid the top button of his collar.
senses.exampleCN: 他解开了衣领上那颗扣子。
senses.why: The verb is un- plus do, so it undoes the doing of a fastening.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词是 un- 加 do，把「系上」这个动作反过来做。

senses.title: To cancel the effect of something
senses.definition: to remove the harm caused by an earlier action
senses.definitionCN: 消除先前行为造成的损害
senses.example: One apology cannot undo years of neglect.
senses.exampleCN: 一句道歉消不掉多年的冷淡。
senses.why: If the effect is a knot, the reversal is an untying, and the same picture serves harm.
senses.whyCN: 若效果是一个结，反转就是解开它，同一个画面也能用来化解伤害。

senses.title: To reverse a step on a computer
senses.definition: to cancel the last command or editing step
senses.definitionCN: 取消上一条指令或编辑步骤
senses.example: Press this key to undo the change.
senses.exampleCN: 按这个键撤销刚才的修改。
senses.why: A command is a knot tied in the machine, and undo pulls the thread back out.
senses.whyCN: 一条指令是系在机器里的结，undo 就是把它抽回去。

senses.title: To bring ruin to a person
senses.definition: to cause someone’s ruin or failure
senses.definitionCN: 使某人身败名裂或事业失败
senses.example: Drink finally undid him.
senses.exampleCN: 酒最终毁了他。
senses.why: To undo a person is to take apart what was built, thread by thread.
senses.whyCN: 毁掉一个人，就是把他建起来的东西一根线一根线拆掉。

senses.title: To come loose by itself
senses.definition: of something fastened, to work loose, or of a plan, to collapse
senses.definitionCN: 指系好的东西自行松开，或计划崩解
senses.example: The whole plan came undone in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 整个计划一周之内就崩了。
senses.why: When the fastening gives way on its own, the word turns intransitive and the thing falls apart.
senses.whyCN: 系紧的东西自己松开时，这个词转为不及物，那东西就此散掉。

intro.en: The word is the English prefix un- set against the oldest English verb.
intro.cn: 这个词是英语前缀 un- 加在最古老的英语动词 do 之前。

items.en: The prefix un- is used to reverse a verb, and dōn means to do or to make.
items.cn: 前缀 un- 用于反转动词，dōn 意为做、作成。

items.en: Undōn is recorded in the sense of opening or unfastening.
items.cn: undōn 已有「打开、解开」之义的记录。

items.en: Middle English undoon keeps that sense and adds the sense of ruin.
items.cn: 中古英语 undoon 保留该义，并添出「毁坏」之义。

items.en: The computing sense of reversing a command arrives in the late twentieth century.
items.cn: 撤销计算机指令的义项在二十世纪后期出现。

items.en: The irregular past forms undid and undone survive intact.
items.cn: 不规则过去式 undid 与过去分词 undone 完整保存至今。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers un- verbs that reverse an action, and the near-meaning group collects verbs of cancelling.
note.cn: 形近组汇集表反向的 un- 动词，近义组汇集表示取消的动词。

normalIntro.en: Un- reverses, and do is the plainest verb, so undo is the plainest reversal.
normalIntro.cn: un- 表反转，do 是最朴素的动词，undo 就是最朴素的反转。

normal.en: The verb is irregular: undo today, undid yesterday, undone in the past participle.
normal.cn: 这个词不规则：现在 undo，过去 undid，过去分词 undone。

normal.en: Undo a button is the everyday sense at a collar.
normal.cn: undo a button 是衣领上最日常的用法。

normal.en: Press undo when a change goes wrong on a screen.
normal.cn: 屏幕上改错了就按 undo。

normal.en: Come undone means something came apart, from a hem to a plan.
normal.cn: come undone 指东西散了，从衣边到计划都行。

normal.en: Undoing as a noun is the thing that ruins a person.
normal.cn: 名词 undoing 指毁掉一个人的那个东西。

abstract.en: Take a tight knot and pull one thread at a time.
abstract.cn: 拿一个紧结，一次抽一根线。

abstract.en: Watch the cloth flatten again as the knot gives way.
abstract.cn: 看结散开后布重新摊平。

abstract.en: Then see a whole plan come loose the same way.
abstract.cn: 再看整个计划以同样方式松散。

examples.en: She undid the knot with her teeth.
examples.cn: 她用牙把那个结咬开了。

examples.en: No amount of money could undo the damage.
examples.cn: 再多的钱也无法消除那场损害。

examples.en: The scandal undid a career of thirty years.
examples.cn: 这场丑闻毁掉了三十年的职业生涯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安堵」——心一安堵，就把缠着的结全解开了。

root: un-（反向前缀）+ do（古英语 dōn「做」）；undōn 原指解开、打开，过去式 undid，过去分词 undone

sensesIntro.en: Every sense reverses a fastening or a building up, whether a button, a harm, a command, a career, or a plan.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都在反转一次系紧或一次建立：纽扣、伤害、指令、事业或计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a knot pulled apart until the cloth lies flat.
core.cn: 核心意象：结被抽开，布重新摊平。

branches.en: The hands branch: buttons, knots, and zips.
branches.cn: 手上分支：纽扣、绳结与拉链。

branches.en: The repair branch: harm and mistakes put right.
branches.cn: 修复分支：纠正伤害与错误。

branches.en: The digital branch: one step back on a screen.
branches.cn: 数字分支：屏幕上退一步。

branches.en: The ruin branch: a person or a plan taken apart.
branches.cn: 毁坏分支：被拆散的人或计划。

branches.en: The plain sense met at a shirt collar.
branches.cn: 衬衫领口最常见的朴素义。

intro.en: A reversing prefix on the simplest of English verbs.
intro.cn: 反向前缀加在英语最简单的动词上。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

definition_zh: 无疑地；毫无疑问；确实
definition_en: used to say that something is certainly true
core_image: 问题一出口，全场没有一个摇头的人
scene: 讲座结束时，主持人问在场有没有人反对这个结论，礼堂里安静了几秒，没有人举手。This is undoubtedly the best solution available.
sceneCN: 这里 undoubtedly 是「毫无疑问」（第 1 个义项：表达确定无疑）；句意为这无疑是目前最好的办法。全场无人摇头，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉 -ly 的形容词，义为「无疑的；公认的」
同源名词，义为「怀疑」
同源形容词，义为「怀疑的；可疑的」

senses.title: Beyond any doubt
senses.definition: used to state that something is certainly true
senses.definitionCN: 用于表明某事确实成立
senses.example: The bridge is undoubtedly the finest in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥无疑是这一带最好的。
senses.why: The adverb is un- plus doubt plus -ed plus -ly, a stack of four pieces saying not doubted at all.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词是 un-、doubt、-ed、-ly 四层叠成，意思就是「一点也没被怀疑」。

senses.title: Used as a hedge in careful writing
senses.definition: used to soften a strong claim while keeping it firm
senses.definitionCN: 用来在保持坚持的同时稍微软化断言
senses.example: Undoubtedly, some details will change.
senses.exampleCN: 显然，有些细节会变。
senses.why: Formal writers like a small pause before the claim, and the adverb supplies it without weakening the claim.
senses.whyCN: 正式写作者喜欢在断言前留一小顿，这个副词在不减弱断言的前提下提供了那一顿。

senses.title: Used for emphasis on a prediction
senses.definition: placed before will to strengthen a forecast
senses.definitionCN: 放在 will 之前加强预测
senses.example: Prices will undoubtedly rise again.
senses.exampleCN: 价格必然会再次上涨。
senses.why: A forecast has no evidence in the present, so the word lends it borrowed certainty.
senses.whyCN: 预测在当下没有证据，这个词便借给它一份确定。

senses.title: Used for emphasis before a superlative
senses.definition: placed before a superlative to confirm the ranking
senses.definitionCN: 放在最高级前确认这一排名
senses.example: She is undoubtedly the most patient of the three.
senses.exampleCN: 她无疑是三人中最有耐心的。
senses.why: A superlative already claims the top, and the adverb confirms that nobody will dispute it.
senses.whyCN: 最高级本身已占住顶端，这个副词只是确认无人会提出异议。

senses.title: In the manner of something not doubted
senses.definition: of a fact, in a way that nobody questions
senses.definitionCN: 就某事实而言，无人质疑地
senses.example: His courage was undoubtedly real.
senses.exampleCN: 他的勇气无疑是真实的。
senses.why: The strength always sits in the doubting that is being denied.
senses.whyCN: 力量始终来自被否定掉的那份怀疑。

intro.en: The word is a four-part English stack on a Latin verb of doubting.
intro.cn: 这个词是四层英语叠加，底座是拉丁语的「怀疑」动词。

items.en: Dubitare means to waver between two things, related to duo, two.
items.cn: dubitare 意为在两者之间摇摆，与 duo（二）相关。

items.en: Old French douter carries the sense of fearing and questioning.
items.cn: 古法语 douter 带出「畏惧、存疑」之义。

items.en: Doubt enters English, and the adjective undoubted adds un- to deny it.
items.cn: doubt 进入英语后，形容词 undoubted 加 un- 加以否认。

items.en: The adverb undoubtedly is formed with -ly and becomes frequent in formal prose.
items.cn: 副词 undoubtedly 加 -ly 而成，在正式文章中频繁出现。

items.en: Modern usage often places it at the start of a sentence as a confident opener.
items.cn: 现代用法常把它放在句首，作为有把握的开场。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the doubt family, and the near-meaning group gathers adverbs of certainty.
note.cn: 形近组共用 doubt 词族，近义组汇集表示确定的副词。

entries.definition: a feeling of not being sure
in a clear and sure way

normalIntro.en: Un- denies the doubt, -ed frames it as a settled fact, and -ly makes it an adverb.
normalIntro.cn: un- 否定怀疑，-ed 把它说成既成事实，-ly 再把它变成副词。

normal.en: Dubitare means to waver between two things, so undoubted means no wavering at all.
normal.cn: dubitare 意为在两者间摇摆，undoubted 就是完全不摇摆。

normal.en: Undoubtedly and undoubtedly true are both common, the second adding emphasis.
normal.cn: undoubtedly 与 undoubtedly true 都常见，后者再加一层强调。

normal.en: In careful writing it softens a claim without giving it up.
normal.cn: 在严谨写作里它软化断言，却不放弃断言。

normal.en: Before will and before a superlative it works as a firm support.
normal.cn: 放在 will 与最高级之前，它起稳固的支撑作用。

normal.en: The adjective form undoubted is rarer but appears in formal prose.
normal.cn: 形容词形式 undoubted 较少用，但见于正式文章。

abstract.en: Ask a room for objections and watch no hand go up.
abstract.cn: 向一屋子人问有没有异议，看没有一只手举起来。

abstract.en: Hear the pause that grows heavier than any answer.
abstract.cn: 听那阵沉默比任何回答都更沉。

abstract.en: Then place that certainty in front of a claim and walk away.
abstract.cn: 再把这份确定放在一句论断前面，转身走开。

examples.en: The discovery is undoubtedly important for farmers.
examples.cn: 这一发现对农民无疑很重要。

examples.en: She is undoubtedly the strongest player in the team.
examples.cn: 她无疑是队里最强的选手。

examples.en: The news will undoubtedly spread by morning.
examples.cn: 这消息到早上必然会传开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的闹特得利」——心里安，闹不清楚的（not）东西都理得利落，自然无疑。

root: un-（否定）+ doubt（拉丁语 dubitare「摇摆不定」，与 duo「二」同源）+ -ed + -ly；现多作副词 undoubted + -ly

sensesIntro.en: One meaning at bottom: the doubt that would normally be there is not there.
sensesIntro.cn: 归根到底只有一个意思：本该出现的怀疑并未出现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a question asked and no hand raised.
core.cn: 核心意象：问题问出，无人举手。

branches.en: The certain branch: a plain statement of fact.
branches.cn: 确定分支：对事实的平实陈述。

branches.en: The hedge branch: softening a claim without dropping it.
branches.cn: 缓和分支：软化而不放弃。

branches.en: The forecast branch: certainty about the future.
branches.cn: 预测分支：对未来的确定。

branches.en: The ranking branch: confirming a superlative.
branches.cn: 排序分支：确认最高级。

branches.en: The everyday use before a plain adjective.
branches.cn: 接普通形容词的日常用法。

intro.en: Four English layers over a Latin verb of wavering.
intro.cn: 四层英语部件叠在一个拉丁语「摇摆」动词上。

latinIntro.en: Dubitare also lies behind dubious and doubt.
latinIntro.cn: dubitare 还支撑着 dubious 与 doubt。

items.example: She was doubtful of the plan.

items.exampleCN: 她无可置疑的技艺令我们佩服。
